approach: Static recompilation of the game into native C, plus a runtime that reproduces the hardware, so no interpreter sits in the hot path.
help: Widescreen margin fidelity across later areas
Reverse engineering additional room and object systems
Playtesting Linux and Windows widescreen builds
notes: Public builds for Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 (v0.9.0+), toolchain only: you supply your own copy of the game and no game data is distributed. Frame-exact against a cycle-accurate reference; 75 of 75 Blargg and Mooneye tests pass. Ships both the 256px widescreen remaster (read-only Codec portrait lip-sync & async eye-blink animation for all 7 main characters, PSX-style Modern Stealth gamepad controls with Square fire, Start->Codec, R1/R2 weapon swap and L1/L2 item swap, animated Codec pause menu with CRT scanlines, 140.85 signal equalizer, procedural UI SFX, 2x5 visual savestate gallery and dynamic Xbox/PS/Nintendo prompts, shader-independent Color Profiles, tactical edge vignette FX for Alert/Low HP, F12 debug snapshots, cartridge RoomMap margins with per-room VRAM cache, margin room/cutscene actors, world props and shadows, centred overlays, cycle-integrated APU audio mastering & crossfeed, GPU GLSL CRT-Lottes & GBC LCD shaders, linear-light LCD response, V-Sync + audio DRC, semantic controller rumble) and the authentic 160px build. Android is planned.
